adjudication.rationale: Verified: the server input schema in `addGuests.schema.ts` defines `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no `.min(1)`, `.max(...)`, or uniqueness refinement. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out existing attendees and blacklisted emails but does **not** dedupe duplicates within the incoming `guests` array, so a request like `["a@x.com","a@x.com"]` can pass and `createMany` will attempt to insert duplicate attendee rows. Client-side `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` in `AddGuestsDialog` does enforce uniqueness, but server-side does not, so bypassing the client can trigger this behavior.
